description:
About Latham & Watkins:

Latham & Watkins is one of the world’s leading global law firms advising the businesses and institutions that drive the global economy. We are the market leaders in major financial and business centers around the world. Our investment in people, commitment to innovation, and focus on the future empower you to build an incredible career and thrive as an exceptional professional in a supportive culture. If you aspire to be the best, and work with the best, this is where you belong.

About the Role:

The Information Governance Analyst is an integral part of Latham’s Information Governance team. This role will be responsible for coordinating one or more primary functions of the Information Governance team, including file management, both physical and electronic, file intake, file releases, destruction requests, data access requests, case room management, and records retention, while communicating regularly with attorneys and paralegals to ascertain the status of projects, developing methods for determining when files are inactive, and handling file movement and processing issues so that only active records are stored in primary on-site space. This role will be located in our New York office. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

Responsibilities & Qualifications:

Other key responsibilities include:

* Assisting with physical file management, including locating and responding to requests for files, ensuring the records management system is up to date and accurate, coordinating and/or performing some or all box archiving and offsite storage procedures
* Providing space coordination, organizing and classifying large document collections in the central filing area, case rooms, file cabinets, offsite storage facilities, or wherever records may be found
* Developing, maintaining, and coordinating appropriate inventory systems to track persons responsible for the files, room usage, file status, location, and other factors related to effective space management and Information Governance Operations oversight
* Assisting with basic and complex reviews and administrative tasks related to file releases, data access requests, and destructions
* Reviewing and preparing files for release to departing attorneys and other firms, using Windows share volumes, iManage, Outlook, and litigation support databases, while correctly implementing firm procedures for the review and disposition of firm-owned material
* Protecting and maintaining any highly sensitive, confidential, privileged, financial, and/or proprietary information that Latham & Watkins retains

We’d love to hear from you if you:

* Possess extensive knowledge of information governance, data security and privacy principles, best practices, and procedures
* Demonstrate thorough knowledge of the physical and electronic resources of the department and firm, and the ability to understand and articulate the role of effective space management in the overall administration of the office
* Exhibit well-developed and professional interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interface with attorneys, management, support staff, clients, and outside contacts

And have:

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; a minimum of four (4) years’ relevant information governance or records experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
* A minimum of three (3) years’ relevant information governance or records experience, preferably in a law firm Information Governance or Records Department
* Experience in other law firm positions having significant document organizational responsibilities may be considered in lieu of directly related information governance or records experience

Benefits & Additional Information:

Successful candidates will not only be provided with an outstanding career opportunity and welcoming environment, but will also be provided with a generous total compensation package

title: Staff Data Center Planner - Space, Power & Cooling
description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

At Crusoe, the Capacity Planning & Efficiency team works where all of Crusoe’s products, services and physical infrastructure meet. As the Staff Data Center Planner for Space, Power & Cooling, you will make sure the following requirements are set for every cluster we plan: data hall space, rack positions, power and cooling that are ready when the hardware arrives. You will work across Crusoe Cloud, our AI cloud platform, and Crusoe’s Digital Infrastructure Group (DIG), which develops, builds and powers our data centers, turning hardware demand into the physical capacity it needs.

The role sits between hardware planning and data center design and operations. You will take forecasted and committed deployments (GPU clusters, CPU and storage servers, network cores) and turn them into rack-level space, power and cooling requirements, check them against what each site can support, and flag gaps early enough to fix them. You will own the data and models that show how much usable capacity we have, where it is stranded, and how to get more out of the sites we already run. At the Staff level, you will set the direction for this work across the whole portfolio and be the technical authority leadership relies on for physical capacity decisions. This work directly supports Crusoe’s mission to align the future of computing with environmental sustainability.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Space, Power & Cooling Fit Checks: Validate that each planned deployment fits its target site and data hall, covering rack positions, kW per rack, air and liquid cooling capacity, and power distribution from utility feed down to the rack. Give a clear go, no-go or at-risk call with the conditions attached.
* Data Hall & Rack Design Inputs: Work with DIG engineering and design teams on data hall layouts, hot aisle containment and row designs, and network core placement. Confirm cabinet power and cooling assumptions for new platforms (for example, 70kW+ liquid-cooled GPU racks) before designs are locked.
* Capacity Inventory & Modeling: Build and maintain one view of space, power and cooling capacity by site, data hall and row: designed, built, energized, allocated and in use. Replace manual analysis with models that combine all three.
* Utilization & Efficiency Metrics: Own metrics such as the Capacity Health Index (actual vs. planned kW relative to actual vs. planned rack units), stranded power and stranded space. Recommend oversubscription, re-layout and consolidation strategies that recover usable capacity.
* Hardware Refresh & Decommissioning: Assess the space, power and cooling impact of retiring older fleets (for example, A100, L40S and MI300X) and replacing them with new platforms, including timing, reuse of existing infrastructure and the sequence of moves.

title: Analyst, Finance & Asset Strategy
description:
**About Middle River Power**

Middle River Power (MRP) is a Chicago-based power generation company that owns and operates more than 8 GW of natural gas, coal, battery storage, and solar generation assets across the United States. We are committed to safe, reliable, and efficient operations.

  

We are a collaborative, fast-paced organization that values ownership, curiosity, adaptability, and creative problem-solving. Our people challenge the status quo, communicate openly, and work together to deliver results.

  

**Position Summary**

The Analyst, Finance & Asset Strategy supports financial analysis, planning, and performance tracking for the Company’s portfolio of power generation assets. The position builds and maintains asset-level financial models, prepares budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses, and turns operating and financial data into clear reporting for the Finance and Asset Strategy team, asset managers, and senior management.

The Analyst works closely with Accounting, Commercial, Operations, and plant teams to gather and validate data, and supports capital, commercial, and portfolio decisions, including acquisitions and financings. This position may be based in Houston, Texas or Chicago, Illinois.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, update, and maintain asset-level financial models that integrate operating, commercial, capital, market, and contractual assumptions.
* Support annual budgets, monthly and quarterly forecasts, and long-range plans for assigned power generation assets.
* Prepare budget-to-actual and variance analyses, identify key performance drivers, and summarize findings for the Finance and Asset Strategy team and asset managers.
* Track asset operating and financial metrics, including availability, generation, revenue, operating and maintenance costs, capital spend, and cash flows.
* Analyze capital projects, outages, contract changes, and commercial opportunities to support investment and operating decisions.
* Prepare dashboards, management reports, and presentation materials for senior management, investors, lenders, and other stakeholders.
* Gather and validate data from Accounting, Commercial, Operations, and plant teams to ensure forecasts and analyses are complete and accurate.

title: BVAL (Bloomberg Evaluated Pricing) Evaluator - CLO
description:
Bloomberg’s BVAL (Bloomberg Evaluated Pricing) group is a market leader in fixed income pricing and the pricing provider to the Bloomberg Indices. BVAL prices over 3 million bonds, multiple times daily for clients across buy side, sell side and custodial clients, including thinly traded and hard-to-price fixed income securities.

**The Role**

We are looking for an Evaluator to join our BVAL Evaluator Team. As a BVAL Evaluator, you will serve as a sector expert responsible for delivering accurate, high-quality pricing data to our clients. In this role, you’ll apply your market expertise, contribute to the development of valuation models, enhance workflow efficiency, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams. You will support valuations for Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs), including Broadly Syndicated Loan (BSL) & Middle Market (MM) CLOs to help advance the BVAL offering, provide accurate pricing, and excellent service to BVAL clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have 5+ years of market experience in the CLOs, with a background in trading, portfolio management, research, structuring, or valuations.

  
  

**We'll trust you to:**

* Leverage market expertise, BVAL’s data-driven framework, and relative value analysis to produce accurate pricing

* Work with internal engineering teams to design, maintain, and enhance valuation models

* Partner with internal teams including Product Management and Sales to expand BVAL’s Securitized Products offering

* Engage directly with clients and colleagues to discuss market dynamics, model assumptions, pricing methodologies, and product features

  
  

**You'll need to have:**

* Proven expertise in fixed income pricing and analytics, including a deep understanding of any of the sectors listed above

* Demonstrated ability to work with complex systems and models, including databases and in-house analytics

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present sophisticated concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and data modeling

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

* Experience trading, investing or analysis of CLOs

* Familiarity with Bloomberg Terminal tools and functionality

* Experience in Python, VBA, SQL and/or Data visualization tools like Superset

  
  

If this sounds like you, please apply!

The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.  

 PLEASE NOTE: To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model. 

 What You’ll Do: 
 Options Investigators in the Division are responsible for conducting focused investigations of trading activities on the Exchanges to detect possible violations of Exchange Rules, By-Laws, and interpretations and policies, and the SEC rules and regulations thereunder, or other improper activities.

 Independently manage investigations from inception to conclusion and completing investigation steps in a timely manner that meet expected guidelines
 Build and maintain a thorough understanding of the Exchanges trading and regulatory environments, as well as the broader securities industry, in areas such as markets, products, relevant rules and regulations, technologies and systems, processes and operational methodologies, and investigative techniques, while contributing to the creation of new investigative processes that address potential regulatory concerns
 Evaluate and analyze matters to identify potential violations as well as the types of evidence, including data and information, necessary to determine whether the activity in question was violative or otherwise improper via thorough research, collection of evidence and fact-finding
 Evaluate and analyze evidence to conclude sufficiency with respect to suspected violations

title: Associate, Loan Originations
description:
**About Faropoint**  
  
Established in 2012, Faropoint is a pure play RE fund manager focusing on the last mile industrial sector. Having acquired more than 500 warehouses to date, it is the most active aggregator of warehouses in the US in the past five years. Our platform is built to harness the sector's fragmentation, operating through 7 regional offices with 120+ employees in vertically integrated teams enhanced by proprietary AI-driven tools, while benefiting from compelling fundamentals like constrained supply growth, reshoring, and e-commerce tailwinds.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Loan Originator Analyst/Associate supports the origination team in sourcing, underwriting, structuring, and closing commercial loans. Suited to someone with 2-5 years in lending, credit, or real estate finance, with an industrial focus.

* **Reports to:** Director of Originations
* **Location:** Hoboken, NJ
* **Travel:** required for property tours, borrower and broker meetings, and industry events

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Source:** build your own network of industrial borrowers, brokers, and sponsors, and originate your own deals, with support from senior originators; maintain the pipeline in the CRM
* **Underwrite:** spread financials, build models (DSCR, LTV/LTC, debt yield), and draft credit memos
* **Execute:** help set terms, covenants, reserves, and pricing within credit policy; coordinate diligence, counsel, title, and closing deliverables; follow underwriting, KYC/AML, and regulatory requirements; hand off to servicing

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, or a related field
* 2-5 years in commercial lending, credit analysis, investment banking, or real estate finance
* Strong Excel financial modeling and working knowledge of credit metrics and loan structures
* Ability to read financial statements, leases, and loan documents
* *Preferred:* industrial CRE lending experience

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Communication and client presence (critical):** this is a client- and prospect-facing role; you will speak and write daily with borrowers, brokers, and sponsors, represent the firm on calls, property tours, and meetings
* **Tech-forward problem solver:** embraces technology and builds solutions that make underwriting and origination faster; experience vibe-coding or working with LLMs is a huge plus
* **Self-starter:** takes initiative, owns deals without being asked, and manages multiple deals to deadline
* **Real estate fundamentals:** understands core real estate principles, including valuation, leasing, market dynamics, and capital structure; industrial knowledge preferred

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary in the $90,000 - $125,000 range, commensurate with experience, plus discretionary bonus
* Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, plus unlimited PTO
* 401(k) plan with company matching
* Collaborative work environment in our Hoboken, NJ headquarters
* Direct mentorship from senior asset management leadership
* Exposure to institutional real estate asset management operations

We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

title: Summer Internship 2027
description:
Company Description 

 The Tudor Group of companies is a group of affiliated companies engaged in investment management of client and proprietary assets. Paul Tudor Jones II formed Tudor Investment Corporation, the first of the Tudor Group companies, in 1980. The Tudor Group manages assets across fixed income, commodities, currencies, public and private equities, and related derivative instruments. The investment strategies of the Tudor Group include, among others, discretionary global macro, quantitative global macro, quantitative equity market-neutral, and equity long-short.

 Tudor offers summer internships to exceptional undergraduate, graduate and PhD students who are interested in applying their unique skills and backgrounds to the financial markets. Internship opportunities are available across our Revenue and Infrastructure. There is a minimum commitment of 10 weeks during summer. 

 The internship role availability also spans across the firm’s global offices.

 Program Highlights 

 Tudor’s internship program is structured to provide interns with both a practical hands-on learning experience and exposure to the various functions within a diverse, global macro strategy alternative investment firm. As a Tudor summer intern, you will have a unique opportunity to work at an intersection of investment management, quantitative analysis, and technology, and will work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, gaining first-hand knowledge of how a world-class alternative asset management firm operates. You will have the ability to build upon your technical skills and industry knowledge while gaining exposure to the firms’ senior business leaders. You will learn about the firms’ history, structure, culture, and core values; receive instruction from experienced members of the financial services community and attend social and networking events with peers and Tudor professionals.

   Education and Skill Requirements 

 Bachelors, Masters, or PhD candidate with desire to work in the financial industry – Technical and quantitative majors/areas of focus are required for Revenue roles.

 Prior to the start of your summer internship at Tudor, you must have completed at least two (2) years of undergraduate studies

 A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5

 Proficient in MS Office Suite (most specifically, Excel)

 Strong problem solving and quantitative skills

 High degree of intellectual curiosity

 Ability to communicate effectively in both verbal and written form

 Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to focus in a dynamic environment

 Ability to prioritize and manage workload

 Hard-working, diligent, and eager to learn in an intellectual and collaborative environment

 Strong intuition and an ability to quickly learn new concepts in a fast-paced environment

 Personal accountability and strong work ethic

 Technical proficiency in one of more of the following programming languages (C++, Python, R, Java, MATLAB) are highly preferred for the select Revenue roles. 

 Salary  (for internships based in the U.S.) 

 Compensation for interns at Tudor has typically ranged from $35 to $55 per hour, with the actual salary dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s education level, work experience and credentials, and/or skill level, geographic location, and other market conditions.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
Optiver is looking for a Risk Analyst to join our growing Risk team and help shape how we identify, measure, and manage trading risk. This is a highly collaborative role at the intersection of risk, trading, quantitative research, and technology. You will work closely with traders to understand complex positions and strategies, develop and challenge risk methodologies, and build tools that improve how we manage risk in fast-moving markets. 

 We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, quantitatively strong, and genuinely interested in financial markets. You should be comfortable digging into data, challenging assumptions, and communicating your conclusions clearly to traders and senior stakeholders. 

 You will join a team that is continuing to evolve and expand, giving you the opportunity not only to manage today's risks, but also to help define the long-term direction of our trading risk framework. 

 What you’ll do 

 As Risk Analyst, your key responsibilities include: 

 Analyze the risk of complex trading positions and portfolios 

 Design, perform, and interpret stress tests and scenario analyses, identifying where our portfolios may be vulnerable to changing market conditions 

 Partner closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and software engineers to develop and enhance risk analytics, tools, and systems 

 Develop and challenge risk methodologies, metrics, and limits, ensuring they remain appropriate as our trading strategies and markets evolve 

 Translate complex risk exposures into clear, actionable insights for traders and senior stakeholders 

 Stay on top of market developments and assess how emerging events and changing market dynamics could affect our positions and strategies 

 Investigate risk incidents and limit breaches, identify root causes, and help determine appropriate actions and improvements 

 Identify weaknesses and opportunities within the existing risk framework and take ownership of driving improvements 

 Contribute to the long-term development of Optiver's trading risk framework, including new analytics, processes, and approaches to risk management 

 Who you are 

 You have at least 1 year of relevant experience 

 You hold a bachelor's or advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related field 

 You have strong quantitative and analytical problem solving skills and enjoy working with complex datasets and problems 

 You are proficient in Python and comfortable using code to analyze data, automate processes, and develop analytical tools 

 You have a strong interest in financial markets, trading, and risk management 

 You are intellectually curious and willing to question assumptions and challenge existing approaches 

 You can communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 40 different countries 

 Highly competitive compensation package including performance-based bonus structure

description:

Are you a curious, quantitatively skilled recent graduate who wants to understand how economic research informs real-world policy? Join the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago’s Research Assistant Program and work alongside economists and researchers on important questions facing the economy, financial markets, businesses, and households.

As a Research Assistant, you will gain hands-on experience across the research process, including managing data, conducting econometric analysis, answering economic questions, and communicating results through compelling charts, written analysis, and presentations. You will contribute to both long-term research and timely policy analysis while building the technical and analytical skills needed for a successful career in economics.

 Collecting, cleaning, managing, and analyzing economic and financial data.

title: 2027 Summer Internship Program – Venture Capital, New York
description:
The Opportunity

 If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you.

 At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals. Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing.

 Overview & Responsibilities

 You will work directly with senior professionals to provide immediate impact on a range of projects:

 This is a highly selective, 10-week internship with Brevan Howard Macro Ventures (BHMV), the world's first macro venture fund – a new investment category uniting macroeconomic and geostrategic analysis with deep-technology investing. We back companies where scientific breakthrough meets national consequence – in energy, artificial intelligence, space, quantum computing and agricultural technology. The thesis is direct. Technology has become the primary axis of geopolitical competition, and the defining companies of this era will be those positioned along the great macro currents: the energy transition, compute sovereignty, orbital infrastructure, defense and food security, to name a few.

Identifying them requires technical depth and macro judgement in equal measure: we begin with structural shifts – where policy, demand, capital and strategic necessity converge – and then work from the bottom up, testing the science, the engineering and the business. Neither a compelling macro narrative nor an elegant laboratory result is sufficient on its own.

Team members have been involved in ventures that redefined access to orbit, the path to fusion power and global compute. Our ambition is to finance the technologies on which the next chapter of civilization depends, and to identify them before their significance becomes consensus.

That work demands two qualities that rarely coincide: the rigor to be right and the imagination to be early. Large language models have made analysis abundant and imagination decisive – provided it is matched by the discipline to test, verify and revise.

An exceptional transcript should be the starting point, not the most interesting thing about you. We are interested in the question you could not leave alone, the model you built to test it, the connection you made that your discipline did not teach you to see. A genuine interest in investing and the commercial consequences of scientific progress is essential.

You will join the investment team in New York, working directly with BHMV's partners and Founding Chief Scientist on live situations: interrogating technical claims, mapping industries, assessing startups, analyzing financials and identifying investment prospects. The questions extend beyond whether a technology works. What does it cost at scale? What bottleneck does it remove or create? Why is now the right moment? Who ultimately captures the value? You will be expected to connect technical evidence to an investment judgement, not simply describe a technology.

The program opens with Brevan Howard's one-week training in financial markets and programming: at BHMV, the macro half of the job is not optional. On-the-job training in venture capital follows, with a mentor program, talks, and interaction with the founders, scientists and macro investors who shape these fields.

The internship is a two-way process: we are assessing you, and you should be assessing us. Its purpose is to find the people we will hire, by converting top-performing interns to our 2028 Graduate Program.

 Why the Investment Banking Graduate Program? 
 Banking provides comprehensive financial advisory, capital raising, financing and risk management services to corporations, governments and financial institutions worldwide. We take an integrated approach to client coverage, providing our clients with access to bankers who have industry and geography specific expertise across all investment banking products.

As a Banking Associate, you will be working with various Investment Banking teams. Here, you’ll come up with the answers to our clients’ most strategic questions. Advising a broad range of corporate clients, you’ll deliver holistic, structured solutions that help our clients deliver on their goals; whether that’s through mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, structured solutions or risk management.

• Financial analysis and modelling

 Investment Banking at Barclays 
 Barclays is one of the world’s top-tier investment banks. We are one of the only non-US, full-service rivals to the biggest US investment banks. And being headquartered in Europe gives us a unique advantage. We think and act differently. From Hong Kong to Houston, and Tel Aviv to Tokyo, everyone at Barclays enjoys a real sense of purpose, because they work for a business that fosters innovation, champions sustainability, and deploys finance responsibly for the common good and the long term.

We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirt, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

title: Campus Full Time 2027 - Quantitative Trader
description:
About Five Rings 

 Five Rings is a proprietary trading firm founded with a vision of combining strategy, innovation and technology to succeed in today’s global markets. With offices in New York, Boca Raton, London and Amsterdam, Five Rings trades in various domestic and international markets, both established and esoteric. Our team constantly seeks new opportunities, analyzes their risks and rewards, and creates strategies and tools to capitalize on them. 

 We have an open culture and encourage the flow of knowledge and ideas between all areas of the firm. 

 About the Role 

 Traders manage their unique strategies in rapidly evolving live markets. They tune model parameters to reflect prevailing conditions, execute trades based on model recommendations, evaluate the real-time feedback provided by market participants’ reactions, and reincorporate this information into their models in a continuous feedback loop. 

 Five Rings gives people as much responsibility as quickly as it can be earned. From day one, as a new Quant Trader (QT), you will gain unrivaled experience both on the desk and in the classroom. 

 New hires work closely with senior traders – analyzing risks and rewards, exploring new strategies, collaborating with quants and software developers to build and optimize trading models. 

 Quant Traders work independently and with others to develop ideas and analyses, and integrate them into our trading strategies and systems. 

 About You 

 Graduating in winter of 2026 or spring/summer of 2027

 Quantitatively-focused

 Thrive in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment

 Quick learner

 Intellectually curious 

 Detail-oriented

 Self-starter 

 Annual Base Salary: $300,000.  Total compensation packages consist of base salary and a discretionary bonus.

 Susquehanna has a job opportunity available for a securities trading attorney to join our in-house counsel/legal team. In this role, you will focus on drafting, reviewing and negotiating agreements related to the trading and financing of securities and other exchange-traded and OTC financial products (ISDAs, MCAs, clearing agreements, prime brokerage agreements, etc.).  Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing situations or urgent requests that may arise with little or no notice

 Ability to exhibit independent judgment when evaluating projects or assignment needs

 Knowledge of Microsoft products (Excel, Word, and Outlook)

 Willingness to work additional and flexible hours on occasion

 Visa sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position now or in the future

**Global Banking and Markets**

Global Banking & Markets provides a full range of investment banking, credit and risk management products and services relevant to the financing and strategic development needs of our clients. Our products include debt and equity financing, mergers & acquisitions, corporate banking, institutional equity sales, trading and research, fixed income products, derivatives, energy, foreign exchange and precious metals. We also cross-sell the full range of wholesale products and services offered by the Scotiabank Group including transaction banking and trade finance solutions.

  

Be part of an innovative Global Capital Markets and Investment Banking business with a unique geographic footprint that puts capital to work for our clients across industries! We work together to drive ambition to every future!

  

**Role Overview**
  
Electronic Execution Services (EES), a core business within Global Equities, delivers Scotiabank's electronic trading offering to institutional clients across Canada, the United States, and international markets. EES combines advanced trading technology, quantitative analytics, market structure expertise, and high-touch client service to provide innovative execution solutions across a broad range of equity trading workflows.

  

As electronic trading continues to transform capital markets, EES is at the forefront of developing and operating sophisticated execution technologies, including algorithmic trading strategies, smart order routing, direct market access (DMA), FIX connectivity, trading analytics, and client-facing execution services. The team works closely with institutional clients, sales, trading, technology, compliance, operations, and external market participants to deliver best-in-class electronic trading capabilities.

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of trading, technology, market structure, and client engagement. Successful candidates will play a key role in supporting and enhancing Scotiabank's electronic trading platform while contributing to strategic initiatives that directly influence client growth, trading performance, and business expansion

  

**What You’ll Do**
  
**Client Coverage & Electronic Trading Support**
  

* Provide exceptional service and support to institutional clients utilizing Scotiabank's electronic trading platform.
* Partner with Sales Trading, Cash Trading, Prime Services, and Client Coverage teams to deliver seamless electronic trading solutions.

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking Associate Analysts based out of our New York office.**  
  
Fitch Ratings is a leading provider of credit ratings, commentary, and research. Dedicated to providing value beyond the rating through independent and prospective credit opinions, Fitch Ratings offers global perspectives shaped by strong local market experience and credit market expertise. The additional context, perspective, and insights we provide help investors to make important credit judgments with confidence.
  
  
**What We Offer:**

* **The Fitch Ratings 2027 Associate Analyst Program (July 2027 cohort)** is an exceptional entry level opportunity for recent graduates. The full-time graduate program is a combination of structured training designed specifically to provide a broad analytical perspective and on-the-job learning experience. As an Associate Analyst, you'll be assigned to a specific Fitch Ratings product group and provided roles and responsibilities that fully immerse you in the credit rating process.
* During the 12-month program, Associate Analysts will get placed in analytical team where they will collaborate with senior analysts on new issuer ratings and gather and analyze the latest industry, regulatory, and economic information. At Fitch, you will receive the training to develop a high level of service to investors and issuers and a team-oriented approach to ratings analysis. Day to day work will include evaluating risk, participation in rating committees, drafting rating affirmations, and writing research reports.

**Application closing date: 29th January 2027**  
  
**We'll Count on You To:**

* Evaluate risk
* Participate in rating committees
* Draft ratings affirmations
* Write research reports

**What You Need to Have:**

* December 2026-June 2027 graduates; with less than 12 months of relevant full-time experience.
* Must be able to work in New York (hybrid office schedule)
* Ability to start July 2027
* Students must have work authorization in the U.S

**We're looking for:**

* Intellectually curious students with financial flair and a keen interest in credit, fixed income and industry analysis.
* Strong, clear, and concise communicators, both verbally and written
* Students from a diverse range of academic backgrounds with a passion for finance, research and analysis are welcome; A plus if you study one or more of the following majors: Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Accounting, and/or Political Science
* Individuals who truly value integrity and objectivity - these are two values we hold ourselves to and pride ourselves on

**Product groups and teams likely to be included are:**

* Structured Finance
* Corporate Ratings
* Financial Institutions
* US Public Finance
* Global Infrastructure and Project Finance Group

Read below to learn more about our different analytical groups.
  
  
**Structured Finance**  
  
Fitch's Structured Finance maintains existing ratings and assigns ratings to new structured finance transactions. Fitch currently rates Structured Finance transactions across four main asset classes: Asset Backed Securities, Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities, Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities and Structured Credit.
  
  
**Corporate Ratings**  
  
The Fitch Ratings Corporates group provides public and private ratings on companies and their debt instruments, including - bank loans, senior and subordinated debt, commercial paper and preferred stock. The group's analytical methodology addresses the legal, regulatory and market environments in over 100 countries in which Fitch Ratings operates, with particular emphasis on debt structure.
  
  
**Financial Institutions**  
  
Fitch's financial institutions' coverage includes not only banks but also finance and leasing companies, securities firms, and asset management organizations. In addition, the group supports dedicated teams for rating specialized securities such as covered bonds.

title: Structured Credit & CLOs - Analyst - New York
description:
**Job Description**  
  
As one of the world's top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a "challenger mindset," you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group
  
  
**Fitch Ratings is seeking an Analyst to join its Structured Credit group to join our New York office** .
  
  
**About the Team:**

* Fitch Ratings is a global company with a presence in over 30 countries, offering opportunities to work with diverse teams and clients from around the world
* A collaborative, team-oriented work environment where excellent communication skills are essential
* An opportunity to be a lead coverage analyst at a global rating agency
* A role that aids debt capital markets in making more informed decisions through timely, insightful, and forward-looking rating actions and research

**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* Analyze new and existing ratings on Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLOs) using proprietary models
* Support transaction analysis, model review and drafting committee materials under guidance of senior team members
* Review transaction documents to identify and assess credit risks
* Prepare and present rating conclusions to a credit committee
* Draft rating action commentaries that explain rating decisions to market participants
* Contribute to recurring and ad hoc research publications

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* You hold a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related quantitative field.
* At least one year of financial-sector experience, preferably but not necessarily related to Structured Credit or Structured Finance.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.
* You have excellent communication skills and can listen actively, incorporating different perspectives in a consensus-driven environment.
* You demonstrate personal responsibility, initiative, and self-management
* Ability to shift and quickly adapt between multiple tasks as priorities change
* You are proficient the Microsoft Excel and Word

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Capital markets, securitization and/or credit analysis experience
* Proven track record of data-analysis of large datasets or working with programming tools, such as SQL, Python, VBA or comparable tools.

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development, and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future

Liquidnet sits within TP ICAP’s Agency Execution division. Acquired by the Group in 2021, Liquidnet is a next‑generation agency execution specialist. Its trading and liquidity network intelligently and securely connects the world’s investors with the world’s investments, helping institutional clients drive alpha through smarter execution.

  

Founded in 1999, Liquidnet was built on the belief that trading could be more efficient, collaborative, and confident. Today, as part of TP ICAP Group, it remains a thriving ecosystem that empowers the buy side in ways never before imagined.

  

**Program Overview**

Our Fixed Income Summer Internship offers a dynamic immersion into the front office trading environment at Liquidnet. Interns gain hands‑on exposure to the processes, relationships, and market activity that drive our fixed income execution business.

  

You’ll be embedded directly within the Fixed Income Sales & Trading team, working alongside professionals who connect institutional clients to liquidity across bonds and credit products. This structure provides both real‑time market learning and opportunities to collaborate across the broader organization.

title: Trading Analyst
description:
IMC is looking for a talented and analytically driven Trading Analyst in New York to join our systematic equities business.

 Our Trading team is responsible for overseeing the real-time trading, performance, and risk of our systematic strategies. Working closely with quantitative researchers, senior leaders, execution engineers, and external partners, the team makes time-sensitive decisions to ensure strategies operate effectively, respond to changing market conditions, and identify opportunities to improve trading performance.

 Your Core Responsibilities:  

 Real-Time Trading Oversight: Monitor live systematic trading strategies, identify anomalies, and take timely action to ensure operational stability and continuity.

 Risk Management: Monitor portfolio exposures, trading activity, and risk limits, escalating and responding to potential risks.

 Performance Analysis: Analyze trading performance, P&L, execution quality, and market behavior to identify opportunities for improvement.

 Research Collaboration: Work closely with quantitative researchers to investigate trading outcomes, evaluate strategy behavior, and support ongoing optimization.

 Technology & Automation: Partner with engineers to improve trading systems, monitoring tools, and automated operational workflows.

 Business Expansion: Support the deployment of new strategies and expansion into new markets, venues, and asset classes.

 Your Skills and Experience:  

 2+ years of experience in a trading analyst, trade support, or trading operations role at a bank or trading firm.

 Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with a degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

 Genuine interest in financial markets, systematic trading, and quantitative research.

 Sound judgment and the ability to make effective decisions under pressure.

 Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across trading, research, and technology teams.

 Experience with Python, SQL, or other programming languages is advantageous.

 We value analytical ability, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

 Please note that immigration sponsorship is not offered for this specific opening. 
 The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits - US | IMC Trading for more comprehensive information.

 Salary Range
 $200,000 — $250,000 USD 

 About Us 

 IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Trading Sneak Peek Program: August 2027
description:
About Akuna:   

 Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration,  cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market-maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models.      

 Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London and Singapore.     

 What you’ll do as a Trading Sneak Peek Program Participant: 

 As a Trading Sneak Peek Program participant you will be enrolled in a crash course on the exciting world of options. You’ll learn from our dedicated trader trainers, as they introduce you to risk management, game theory, and optimal decision making. Outside the classroom, you’ll have the opportunity to apply your knowledge in real time.    

 Are you ready for a “sneak peek” into life as an options market maker? Does mastering the educational trading games and simulations used by our entry-level traders sound like fun? Would you like to shadow our trading desks to learn about Akuna's unique approach to acting as a global liquidity provider/market maker? If your answer is yes, our Sneak Peek Program is right for you!     

 Program details:
 The Sneak Peek Program is an educational program held in person at Akuna's Chicago headquarters. By applying to the August 2027 Trading Sneak Peek Program, you will be considered for one of the following sessions:   

 Session 1: August 16 - 18, 2027 

 Session 2: August 19 - 20, 2027 

 You will have the opportunity to indicate your preferred session in your application, and we will do our best to accommodate it throughout the recruitment process.     

 Additional program perks: 

 Round-trip travel and accommodations 

 Daily lunch 

 AkunaU lectures from the firm’s leaders     

 Roundtable networking sessions   

 Fun events showcasing our firm and the city of Chicago     

   Qualities that make great candidates:     

 Graduating between December 2027 – July 2028     

 Pursuing a BS/MS/ PhD in engineering, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, actuarial science or a related/equivalent field     

 Able to attend in person at Akuna’s Chicago headquarters  

 Entrepreneurial self-starter ready to work in a fast paced, collaborative, team environment     

 Strong math, numerical, and quantitative skills     

 Demonstrable interest in trading and the financial markets      

 In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us! 

 Please note: By submitting an application for th e August   Trading Sneak Peek Program , you acknowledg e you will not be considered for other Trading Sneak Peek Program sessions (January and May 2027) at Akuna this recruiting season . Thi s acknowledgement does not limit applications to other Tech and/or Quant roles - in addition to this program , you may apply to any Tech and/or Quant roles of interest.  

 This is an unpaid educational program. Akuna provides round-trip travel, housing, lunch, and social events for all participants.

This seat sits within the team’s corporate coverage effort and is focused primarily on interest rate solutions: helping corporate treasury and finance teams manage the rate risk that comes with their balance sheets, their debt financings and their strategic transactions.

DRSA works where the bank’s lending, capital markets and M&A relationships meet the trading desk. A corporate client refinancing a term loan, pre-funding a bond issue, closing an acquisition or reshaping its fixed/floating mix needs a hedge that fits its financing, its accounting and its risk appetite. The team’s job is to spot those needs early, design the right solution, price it competitively with trading, and see it through execution and the life of the trade.

The team runs a lean, entrepreneurial model with a high bar. Junior team members are not confined to one lane: you will work directly with senior marketers on live pitches and transactions, build and price structures yourself, join client meetings, and over time take on coverage responsibility of your own. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell.  Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney.  Quote and trade SOFR options and multi-leg structures in the pit.

 Fast mental math, composure under pressure

You’ll own the execution and optimization of Tomo’s organic social channels, from concept to camera to analytics. Then you’ll read the data, work out why something landed (or didn’t), and make the next one better.

This is a hands-on creative role where you’ll be both in front of the camera and behind it, filming yourself and our team (sales, ops, leadership, etc.) to create content that grows our audience and drives measurable results.

You’ll work closely with the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, who sets the overall marketing, growth, and brand strategy, and alongside peer GMMs owning paid media and organic search.

* Write hooks, scripts, captions, and on-screen copy that make mortgage concepts worth watching and engaging with.
* Support the AEO/SEO GMM on long-form YouTube production, from filming and editing to cutting long-form into short-form clips.

**Channel Strategy & Formats**

* Execute and evolve Tomo’s organic social strategy: content pillars, series, the content calendar, and platform-specific approaches.

* Track trends, sounds, and formats in real time across personal finance, real estate, and internet culture. Turn them into on-brand content fast, and know when a trend is already over.

**Analytics & Experimentation**

* Own organic social KPIs such as reach, hook rate, watch time, saves and shares, follower growth, and the site traffic and leads that come from social. Reporting should come with clear, data-backed recommendations.
* Run structured creative tests such as hooks, formats, length, talent, and posting cadence, and keep what you learn in a living playbook.

* Work within our review process. Mortgage-related content goes through internal and compliance review before posting, since we’re a regulated lender. Build workflows that keep speed high without cutting corners.
* Manage community engagement across comments and DMs.

title: Floor Trader (BOX)
description:
Old Mission is a global proprietary trading firm that leverages state-of-the-art technology and research to identify and execute profitable trading strategies across multiple asset classes around the world. Our offices in Chicago, New York, and London are all composed of naturally-curious individuals who thrive in a team environment and constantly strive for improvement.

About The Position

We are seeking a seasoned BOX Floor Trader to join our trading operations in Chicago. The ideal candidate will execute and manage order flow on the BOX trading floor, provide liquidity, facilitate institutional and broker-dealer trades, and capture market-making opportunities across equities, options, and exchange-traded products (ETPs).

This role combines proprietary technology with traditional open-outcry price discovery. We are placing a strong emphasis on candidates with demonstrated prior options open outcry market making experience, a track record of floor-based execution, and deep familiarity with single-stock equity, index, or ETF volatility.



Responsibilities

 - Quote, facilitate, and trade broker flow in assigned options, equities, and ETF products, providing consistent liquidity and supporting efficient, orderly markets on the BOX floor.

 - You removed that for the following – Provide liquidity and participate in price discovery across assigned securities and ETFs.

 - Execute floor-based, voice-assisted, or hybrid options and equity trades with precision, identifying opportunities and representing resting order flow effectively in an open-outcry environment.

 - Apply proprietary pricing software, volatility models, and risk management frameworks to monitor real-time order flow, manage positions, and respond swiftly to market volatility or order imbalances.

 - Partner directly with electronic trading desks, quantitative research teams, and technologists to optimize workflows, enhance pricing tools, and improve overall execution performance.

 - Maintain clear, effective, and continuous communication with floor brokers, counterparties, and internal trading desks to ensure optimal execution and strong team coverage.

 - Adhere strictly to BOX exchange rules, SEC regulations, and internal risk and compliance policies.

What You’ll Need

 - 2+ years of options market-making experience with direct, hands-on floor trading/open-outcry experience on an exchange floor (e.g., NYSE Arca, CBOE, MIAX, or comparable physical floor).

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

 - Deep understanding of options pricing models, volatility analysis, market microstructure, liquidity provision, and underlying ETF/index basket relationships.

 - Strong numerical and analytical capabilities, with the ability to quickly evaluate trades and solve complex math or logic problems under pressure.

 - Demonstrated ability to make high-quality decisions rapidly in high-pressure, fast-paced market conditions.

 - Exceptional verbal communication and interpersonal skills, necessary for active trading pit negotiations and seamless team collaboration.

 - Certifications: Required active Series 57 

Base Salary Range 

$150,000 - $200,000 - Salaries are based on numerous factors such as skills, experience, and education. Our compensation package also includes a discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits program for full-time employees. For more information, reach out to your recruiter. 



 

Old Mission is not accepting unsolicited resumes from any staffing/search firms. All resumes submitted by staffing/search firms to any employee at Old Mission via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid signed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Old Mission, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Old Mission.

Duties: Trade and manage repurchase agreements to finance the broker dealer unit of the firm, and to market-make in Treasury repurchase agreements as a liquidity provider for clients. Develop specialness-driven trading strategies, identify and trade Treasury securities that are priced at a premium around auction cycles, settlement windows, cheapest-to-deliver switches, supply shortages, and settlement failures. Build and maintain proprietary models to forecast specialness events using auction data, open interest, and settlement failure analytics. Track implied repurchase agreement rates across Treasury futures to identify and trade cash-futures mispricing, accounting for delivery optionality and collateral financing. Manage settlement fails across primary and secondary markets, evaluating their effect on repurchase agreement yields and General Collateral rates, and structure trades to capture funding arbitrage from these settlement dynamics. Express relative value views across broader USD Rates markets, adjusting exposure based on macroeconomic factors such as Treasury supply, hedging flows, and fiscal events, while managing duration and spread risk within the book. title: Sell Side Research Analyst
description:
**About Ornn**
--------------

Ornn is building the financial infrastructure for AI compute. Our price indices are live on Bloomberg Terminal. We structure and trade compute hedging instruments. And we're now building a platform that brings exchange-grade mechanics like order management, matching, scheduling, and settlement to how compute capacity gets reserved and allocated. We're a lean team in New York, backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

### **About the Role**

GPU compute is turning into an asset class, and almost nobody is writing about it with real data. You would be Ornn's first dedicated research analyst, publishing the work that hedge funds, consultancies, lenders and operators read to understand where compute prices are going and why.

You'll sit at the center of Ornn Data. Our index draws on more than 150 providers and roughly 1,000 transactions a day, and you'll turn that into research our clients pay for and our sales and markets teams use in every conversation.

### **What You'll Do**

* Publish regular research on the compute market: weekly pricing notes, monthly market reports, and deeper pieces on GPU generations, supply coming online, contract terms and residual values.
* Cover the companies that shape the market: hyperscalers, neoclouds, chipmakers, data center developers and their capex plans.
* Take calls with institutional clients, consultancies and lenders, and present at client meetings and industry events.
* Manage our freelance writers and researchers, set the research calendar and hold the bar on quality.

**Requirements**

* 1 to 4 years in equity or credit research, commodities research, or a research role at a fund, data provider or consultancy.
* Strong modeling skills in Excel and comfort working with large datasets.
* Clear, fast writing. You can turn a messy dataset into a sharp one-page view with a point of view.
* Real curiosity about AI infrastructure and how compute is bought, sold and financed.
* Comfortable working independently in a lean team.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Sell side coverage of semiconductors, data centers, cloud or TMT.
* Experience with commodity markets, benchmarks or index products.
* Python or SQL.
* An existing following or published work in the AI infrastructure space.

### **Why This Role Matters**

A market only works when people trust the information about it. Ornn's index, futures work with ICE and data business all depend on being the most credible voice on what compute costs. This role is how that credibility shows up in the world every week, and how Ornn becomes the first place institutions go to understand the asset.

### **Compensation and Benefits**

Benefits include competitive salary, meaningful equity, health coverage, meals, and additional benefits.

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Ornn is committed to building a diverse team. We evaluate candidates based on their ability to do the work, not on pedigree or background. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

This is a client facing role and you will be expected to have the ability to present your work clearly and communicate effectively with clients at all levels.

Our clients value our forecasts and market views and our analytical work is focused on creating forward looking views backed by data. Ideally, you will have experience in forecasting methods, timeseries analysis, statistics and energy economics and we will help you develop these skills further.

* Writing analytical pieces focusing on wholesale power prices, demand for electricity and thermal generating fuels, and the buildout of generating capacity, all through the lens of a changing regulatory landscape.

* Continuously seeking to increase your market knowledge and widen your network of contacts.

* Tracking developments in the US power markets, including capacity buildouts, load growth and regulatory and policy changes.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* Fluent in English (speaking, reading, writing)

* Interest in financial markets, macroeconomics, statistics, and investment modeling

* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; reasonable proficiency with Bloomberg, databases, and other analytic tools preferred
* Ability to relay complex ideas clearly
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Desire to join a high performance, fast-paced culture
* Results-orientation, attention to detail and strong time management skills
* CFA designation or active status in program desired

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

**Pricing Analyst (Revenue Management)**
----------------------------------------

Industrious is the largest premium flexible workspace company in the world, operating over 250 locations across 10 countries as part of the CBRE portfolio. We design workplaces where teams feel welcomed, supported, and able to do their best work. The same principle guides how we work together as a company.

**About the Role**
------------------

Right now, the pricing judgment for Industrious's existing North America private office portfolio sits with one person who has built deep expertise in it: knowing which renewals need a bump, which office needs a promotion instead of a price cut, and which market is quietly slipping. That person is moving on to bigger things, and we need someone to step into that seat, formalize what works, and keep roughly 200 price changes a month running accurately, on time, and grounded in real conversations with the General Managers who run our buildings.

This is a Pricing Analyst, Revenue Management role, reporting into the pricing team. You will own business-as-usual pricing execution for the existing North America private office portfolio, with the scope to grow into other products and regions as the team expands.

**What Might Your Day Look Like**
---------------------------------

You start the morning scanning the pricing dashboard and notice a suite at 1411 Broadway that hasn't sold in weeks, while the identical suite next door is occupied at full list price. The GM has asked for a price cut. You pull the tour and application data, see it's a single-unit problem rather than a market problem, and decide a one-month promotion makes more sense than dropping the list price and setting up a harder renewal conversation down the road.

By mid-morning, you are on the phone with a GM in Nashville, walking through why an entire category of seven-to-nine person offices isn't moving. You ask about tour volume, application quality, and whether the floor plans still fit what people are searching for. You leave the call with a plan, and the GM leaves it feeling like someone actually looked at their building, not just their numbers.

In the afternoon, you work through the week's renewal batch, running each one against the pricing logic the team uses to decide what gets pushed through and what needs a second look. You flag one segment where occupancy has slipped two months running, log it for deeper review, and jot down a note on the decision tree so the next person doesn't have to relearn it from scratch.

You close the day updating the system with the changes you've made, checking your numbers against the portfolio report, and sending a short note to your manager on the one call that needs a decision above your pay grade.

This position offers a fantastic opportunity to grow your expertise in risk analysis, financial modeling, and data-driven decision-making within a fast-paced environment.

* **Monitor Account Funding Status & Issue Margin Calls** Review margin adequacy in client accounts, issue margin call notifications, and follow up on the status of client funding replenishment.
* **Market Risk Monitoring & Early Warning** Closely track market volatility, trading activity, and client risk exposures. Proactively identify potential risks and issue risk alerts or trading restriction notices as needed.
* **Track P&L and Margin Fluctuations** Monitor intraday trading profit/loss (P&L) and margin movements, and assess risk exposures and hedge positions.

* **Specialized Risk Analysis & Project Execution** Participate in risk analysis projects as assigned, including stress testing, Value-at-Risk (VaR) calculations, and market extreme scenario simulations.

**Requirements**

* Strong understanding of financial concepts such as credit analysis, cash flow analysis, and risk management principles

title: Quant Risk Analyst - Derivatives & Clearing
description:
**About Polymarket**
--------------------

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform, where people trade on the outcomes of real-world events. As our markets, volumes, and derivative product suite grow, so does the sophistication of the risk infrastructure behind them. Our clearing and risk systems must operate with the rigor of a traditional clearinghouse while moving at the speed of a crypto-native trading platform.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a mid-level quantitative risk analyst to design and implement enterprise-scale risk models at the heart of our clearing operation. You'll own models for market risk, volatility and correlation of derivatives, stress testing, and automated liquidation — the systems that keep the platform solvent and users protected in fast-moving markets.

This is a hands-on role: you'll be building models in production code, not just specifying them. We expect you to work fluently with AI tools for development and research — and to be the skeptic in the room, pressure-testing AI-generated models and code against well-established risk frameworks before anything ships.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale risk models covering market risk, margin, and counterparty exposure for a clearing organization.
* Build volatility and correlation models for derivatives, including calibration, backtesting, and ongoing model validation.
* Develop and run stress-testing frameworks: historical scenarios, hypothetical shocks, and reverse stress tests.
* Design and tune auto-liquidation logic — trigger thresholds, liquidation waterfalls, and safeguards against cascading liquidations.
* Use AI tools extensively to accelerate model development, coding, and research — and rigorously validate AI outputs against established risk models (VaR/ES, SPAN-style margining, GARCH-family volatility models, standard correlation frameworks) before deployment.
* Monitor model performance in production, investigate breaks, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with engineering, trading, and product teams to embed risk controls into platform architecture.
* Document model assumptions, limitations, and validation results to an audit-ready standard.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5–7 years of quantitative risk experience at a clearinghouse, exchange, prime broker, trading firm, or similar.
* Proven expertise designing and implementing risk models at enterprise scale — production systems, not just research prototypes.
* Deep experience modeling volatility, correlation, option skews, option pricing and implementing at scale for trad-fi derivatives, perpetuals, and fully collateralized event contracts.
* Hands-on experience with market risk modeling, stress testing, and auto-liquidation mechanics in a clearing context.
* Strong fluency with AI-assisted development and coding, paired with the judgment to pressure-test AI outputs against well-established risk models and catch what looks plausible but is wrong.
* Expert-level Python (numerical stack: NumPy, pandas, SciPy; solid software engineering practices).
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, physics, financial engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.
* Strong mathematical foundation in stochastic calculus and linear algebra.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* C# and/or C++ for performance-critical or production systems.
* Familiarity with crypto market structure, perpetuals, or prediction markets.
* Experience with CCP risk frameworks (CPMI-IOSCO PFMI, default management, margin methodology).
* Experience building real-time risk systems.

**Pay Transparency**

title: Algorithmic Trader - Delta One
description:
Our employees are our greatest asset. We have spent years building a team of talented, dedicated technologists, data-driven traders, and expert leaders with an emphasis on our core pillars:People, Process, Trading Edge, and Technology. Simplex is an in-office organization, helping to foster a collaborative and communicative culture.

**Career Description**

We’re hiring an Algorithmic Trader focused on CME equity index futures. You’ll build and run short-horizon strategies at microsecond-to-second timescales: turning full-depth order book data into predictive signals, designing passive market-making logic for ES, and working with our C++ and FPGA developers to get your ideas into production. This role suits someone who has traded or researched ES/NQ in a low-latency environment and enjoys taking an idea from raw market data to live trading.

**What you will be doing**

* Research and build short-horizon (microsecond to second) price-prediction signals for CME equity index futures from full-depth order book and trade data: order aggressiveness, queue position, cancels, icebergs, and leads from related futures and cash equities.
* Own the signal pipeline end to end: packet-capture data, feature design, sampling, model fitting (linear and tree-based), pruning, out-of-sample simulation, and deployment with C++ and FPGA developers.
* Design and tune a passive ES market-making strategy: level joining, queue-priority value, order spacing, cancel/replace timing, exchange messaging limits, and protective pulls when latency or connectivity degrades.
* Model the matching engine: turn fill latency and book state into estimates of how many levels traded and future price changes, then use this information to move quotes, purge, and take liquidity in futures, index options, and equities.
* Measure and improve latency: profile order paths in microseconds, reconcile wireless and fiber timestamps across data centers, compare vendor signal feeds, and quantify misses against exchange reports.
* Write specs for developers, verify their output against your own calculations, and find bugs in production data and pricing pipelines.

Skills and experience

* 2+ years trading or researching CME equity index futures (ES/NQ) at a proprietary trading firm with sub-millisecond systems.
* Hands-on experience with CME MDP 3.0 order-by-order market data: book building, queue-position tracking, iceberg and self-match-prevention inference, matching-engine latency behavior.
* Built microprice or alpha models that ran live at microsecond horizons. Fluent in lead/lag analysis, half-lives, markouts, and adverse selection.
* Passive quoting experience on FIFO futures markets: queue value, join and cancel logic, messaging-efficiency constraints, mass-quote protections.
* Python research stack (polars or pandas, numpy, gradient-boosted trees, SQL). Reads C++. Has worked alongside FPGA or low-latency engineers.
* Bonus: index basis and roll (cash, futures, BTIC), SPX options, or microwave network latency.
